title: A Butterfly Lighter Than a Gram Flies 9,000 Miles. Nobody Finishes
subject: painted lady butterfly

scenes.text: A butterfly weighing less than a gram flies 9,000 miles. And no single one ever finishes the trip.
Painted ladies travel between tropical Africa and the Arctic Circle, nearly twice as far as the monarch.
The journey takes up to six generations. Each butterfly flies one leg, lays eggs, and dies.
The ones flying south in autumn were born in Europe. They have never seen Africa.
They climb high, often over 350 meters and sometimes above a kilometer, to ride favorable winds.
Those winds carry them about 30 miles an hour, more than twice their own speed. A tiny insect borrows the sky.

description:
